start.title: Ready in one afternoon

steps.d: Sign in with Google, enter the masjid's name and choose its location. The JAKIM zone is set for you.
We check each registration, usually within 1–2 working days. You will get an e-mail.
Open masjidview.my/tv on the TV. Enter the 6-digit code on your phone.
Choose a template or upload a poster. It appears on the TV within a minute.

needs: ✓ A TV with a web browser (or an Android TV box / laptop)
✓ An AJK Google account or e-mail

items.a: Yes. There are no registration fees, subscriptions or hidden charges for masjids and suraus.

items.q: What kind of TV can I use?
items.a: Any TV with a modern web browser: an Android smart TV or Google TV, an ordinary TV with an Android TV box, or a laptop connected to the TV by HDMI.

items.q: Do I need to download an app?
items.a: There is no Masjid View app to install. Masjid View runs in a web browser: download and open any web browser app on the TV, then go to masjidview.my/tv.

items.q: Where do the prayer times come from?
items.a: They are based on JAKIM e-Solat data for your masjid's zone. You can check today's times while you register.

items.q: Does it need internet all the time?
items.a: No. Internet is needed to update announcements. Prayer times are stored on the TV, so the screen keeps working if the WiFi drops.

items.q: Can I change the iqamah minutes?
items.a: Yes. Administrators set the iqamah minutes for each prayer, and the length of the Friday khutbah.

items.q: How many people can manage one masjid?
items.a: Two administrators with the same access. The first administrator invites the second by e-mail. Each account can manage only one masjid. When the AJK changes, an administrator can remove and invite again, or contact us.

items.q: Can I use more than one TV?
items.a: Yes. Each screen is set up with its own code and can use a different theme and layout.

items.q: Can a small surau use it too?
items.a: Yes. Masjid View suits large masjids and small suraus alike.
We keep only what is needed to run the display. Death notices are deleted automatically. Read the Privacy Notice for details.

meta.title: TV setup guide — Masjid View
meta.description: How to set up the Masjid View screen on an Android smart TV, an Android TV box or a laptop, and pair it with a 6-digit code.

panduan.title: TV setup guide
panduan.intro: Set up the Masjid View screen in about 30 minutes. Choose the way that suits your TV, then pair the screen with a 6-digit code from the AJK panel.
panduan.before: Before you start: connect the TV to the masjid WiFi that stays on all day (not a phone hotspot), and make sure the date, time and Kuala Lumpur time zone (GMT+8) are correct.

sections.title: Android smart TV / Google TV
steps: On the TV, open Google Play. Search for and install a web browser app.
Open the browser and type the address https://masjidview.my/tv
If the browser has a start page or home page setting, set it to the same address.
If the browser can open by itself when the TV is switched on (start on boot or kiosk mode), turn that on so the screen comes back after a power cut.
In the TV settings, turn off the screen saver and sleep mode so the screen stays on.

img.alt: A web browser on an Android TV opening masjidview.my/tv

sections.title: Ordinary TV + Android TV box
steps: Plug the Android TV box into the TV's HDMI port and connect the box to WiFi.
Choose the right HDMI input with the TV remote.
On the box, follow the same steps as for the Android smart TV above.
Check the box's settings (Display or Power) so it does not go to sleep.

img.alt: An Android TV box connected to the HDMI port at the back of a TV

sections.title: Laptop over HDMI
steps: Connect the laptop to the TV with an HDMI cable and choose the HDMI input on the TV.
Open a web browser and go to https://masjidview.my/tv
Press F11 (or choose Full screen in the browser menu) so the page fills the TV.
In the power settings, set the laptop never to sleep and never to turn the screen off.

img.alt: A laptop connected to a TV with an HDMI cable, showing full screen

sections.title: Pair the screen with the 6-digit code
steps: Once masjidview.my/tv is open, the TV shows a 6-digit code and a QR code.
On your phone, sign in at masjidview.my/admin and open Screens, then Add screen.
Enter the code (or scan the QR code) and give the screen a name, for example Main hall.
Within a few seconds the TV shows your masjid's prayer times and announcements.
The code expires after 10 minutes. The TV shows a new code by itself.

img.alt: A TV screen showing a 6-digit pairing code and a QR code

items.a: Prayer times keep showing because they are stored on the TV. New announcements appear again when the connection is back.

items.q: The time or clock is wrong
items.a: Make sure the device's time zone is Kuala Lumpur (GMT+8) and the date is right. The screen corrects small differences itself, but a wrong time zone confuses it.

items.q: The screen turns off or goes to sleep
items.a: Turn off the screen saver, sleep mode and auto power off in the TV, box or laptop settings.

items.q: The pairing code is not accepted
items.a: Codes expire after 10 minutes. Reload the page on the TV to get a new code, then try again.

items.q: The TV shows the pairing code again
items.a: That screen was removed in the AJK panel. Pair it again with a new code.
